value.rationale: The nontransitive regular cyclic tournament is a canonical infinite sequence in directed graph Hom topology. A uniform S1 classification of complexes whose dimensions grow without bound resolves a motivated family in a published open direction; the special order-nine Hom computation already establishes concrete prior interest. An explicit cyclic-interval fiber model gives structural insight and a reusable proof, beyond routine finite tabulation.
